newsitem.title: USA: US Midco diesel differentials ease as stocks build.
newsitem.headline: US Midco diesel differentials ease as stocks build.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot low sulphur diesel basis eased Tuesday on a build in distillate stocks in the region, while gasoline differentials were steady, traders said.

Low sulphur diesel inventories on hand at Midwest refineries rose 810,000 barrels last week, while high sulphur diesel stocks were drawn down 357,000 barrels, the American Petroleum Institute said in its weekly stocks survey.
The draw fueled a drop in spot diesel fuel differentials and a general correction in the cash market, traders said.
"There's a lot of weakness in the cash," one trader said.
Group Three prompt low sulphur diesel differentials eased 0.50 cent a gallon to bids even with the print, while later deliveries were steady at 0.25 cent under to even with the print, traders said.
Chicago low sulphur diesel made a similar downward move to bids 1.75 cents a gallon over NYMEX December heating oil for prompt and later deliveries.
Group Three unleaded eased to bids 3.0 cents a gallon over the print for prompt deliveries and remained 0.50 cent over for later deliveries, with premium 1.25/1.50 cents higher.
Chicago prompt unleaded gasoline was steady at 3.75/4.0 cents a gallon over NYMEX December unleaded gasoline, with later deliveries one cent weaker, traders said.
